rtsa gsum srung ma'i gtor 'bul bsdus pa dngos grub myur ster zhes bya ba ni/rin po che'i snod du gtor ma dkar dmar rgyan ldan thebs kyus spras pa

tei:div.tei:p: )*rtsa gsum srung ma'i gtor 'bul bsdus pa dngos grub myur ster zhes bya ba ni/ rin po che'i snod du gtor ma dkar dmar rgyan ldan thebs kyus spras pa gser skyems bcas bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhan+dza 'bar ba'i nang*// gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar// 'bru gsum byin brlabs ye shes bdud rtsi'i mtsho// 'dod yon mchod sprin nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis byin brlabs/ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal thugs ka nas// 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros// rtsa gsum chos skyong dam can nor lha'i tshogs// mdun mkhar spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs la/ hūm̐ hrī/ chos dbyings zhing nas rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha// dur khrod brgyad dang nyer bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// dpal mgon dam can chos skyong rgya mtsho'i tshogs// dam tshig dbang gis glog ltar myur gshegs la// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs dam ye dbyer med par// dgyes pa'i gdan la badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha lhan// dngos 'byor yid sprul phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul// sman raka dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la// mchog thun las bzhi'i dngos grub thogs med stsol/ zhes spyi tsam dang*/ bye brag so sor sger mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ hrī/ kun bzang rdor 'chang rigs lnga rdo rje sems// snang mtha' spyan gzigs rta mchog pad+ma dbang*// dga' rab rdo rje shrī sengha dang*// pad+ma lhun mdzad rig 'dzin rnam pa brgyad// khyab bdag bla ma mtsho skyes rdo rje dang*// thod phreng sde lnga gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad// sprul sku drug sogs bye ba phrag brgya'i tshogs// ye shes mtsho rgyal khri srong sa le 'od// rje 'bangs nyer lnga las can mchan bu'i tshogs// bsam gtan gling pa pad+ma bde byed rol// brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma thams cad kyis// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// byang chub bar du bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// yang ti bla ma yid bzhin nor bu yi// tshom bu dgu yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*// 'od dpag med mgon sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor lha// tshe dpag lha tshogs spyan gzigs lha tshogs dang*// pad+ma zhi khro sgyu 'phrul zhi ba'i tshogs// rdor sems snying thig drag po kī la ya// bla ma dgongs 'dus tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor dang*// yi dam dgongs 'dus rta mchog rol pa'i tshogs// brgya dang so bdun dbang chen rtsa ba'i lha// bdud 'dul drag phur bdun cu rtsa drug 'khor// rdo rje drag rtsal sprul 'khor bka' sdod dang*// rgyud sde drug dang sgrub sde bka' brgyad sogs// theg pa rim dgu'i yi dam lha tshogs kyis// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phobs// rdo rje phag mo rje btsun sgrol ma yum// mtsho rgyal lha tshogs bde chen rgyal mo dang*// khros ma nag mo bdud 'dul seng gdong ma// nyer bzhi so gnyis gnas yul dur khrod nas// ye shes las dang 'jig rten tshul 'dzin pa'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lus pa med pa'i tshogs// dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// bar chad kun sel rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs// dpal ldan ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa// bya rog gdong can phyag drug gur gyi mgon// legs ldan ma ning dbyings yum mu kha le// mchod gtor 'di bzhes rnal 'byor phrin las sgrubs// sku mgon stag zhon gsung mgon bing dmar dang*// thugs mgon gri gug yon tan seng zhon che// phrin las trak+shad nag po 'khor bcas kyis// mchod gtor 'di bzhes rnal 'byor bar chad sol// sngags srung e ka tsa ti ber nag can// dpal ldan lha mo dud sol re ma ti// srog len mched gsum sngags srung spyang zhon mas// mchod gtor 'di bzhes rnal 'byor phrin las sgrubs// rta nag dregs pa sha za kha mo che// shwa na bdag nyid sa bdag bswe lcags ging*// dur khrod bdag po yab yum ngas nus mas// mchod gtor 'di bzhes mi mthun rkyen ngan sol// zhing skyong seng ge'i gdong can yab dang yum// tshe ring mched lnga gnod sbyin shan pa che// phag gdong mched lnga 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// mchod gtor 'di bzhes rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs// gza' bdud chen po dregs pa sde lnga dang*// dam can skyes bu rdo rje legs pa rtsal// rdo rje g.yu sgron btsan rgod rdor legs kyis// mchod gtor 'di bzhes dgra bgegs thal bar rlogs// rnam mang thos sras nor bdag dzam bha la// rta lha re man+ta dang ku bai ra// mkha' 'gro don grub sprul pa sde bzhi'i tshogs// mchod gtor 'di bzhes 'dod rgu'i dngos grub stsol// lha chen dbang phyug u ma dā+e wi yum// chos rgyal sku lnga las mkhan tsit+ta dmar// rdo rje brag btsan bdud rgyal sbrul mig can// mchod gtor 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthun rkyen spel// spu gri mched gsum nyang gi lha btsan dang*// rol pa skya bdun klu rgyal gzi khra dang*// 'bangs blon mched gsum gter bdag ḍā ki lngas// mchod gtor 'di bzhes bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol// thang lha spom ra sprag dbyi 'khor bcas dang*// mgur lha bcu gsum dge bsnyen nyi shu gcig

/sde dpon sum cu brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*// snang srid lha srin dregs pa sde brgyad sogs// pad+ma'i bka' bzhin dkar phyogs skyong rnams kyis// mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs// che mchog he ru ka dang thod phreng rtsal// dbang chen nus ldan rdo rje'i spyan snga ru// zhal bzhes bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba yi// dam can rgya mtsho lus pa med pa'i tshogs// dam rdzas brgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rgyal bstan rin chen srung zhing spel ba dang*// dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang dgung la bstod// dge 'dun sde rgyas snyan pa'i dar chen phyor// grags pa'i dung sgras sa gsum khyab par mdzod// yul dus 'di dang rgyal khams thams cad du// nad yams 'khrug rtsod mi mthun kun zhi zhing*// char chu dus 'bebs lo phyug rtag tu legs// 'gro kun bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod// khyad par gsang chen snying po'i ring lugs kyi// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur bsgreng ba dang*// bstan 'dzin sde rnams dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing*// mdzad phrin nam mkha'i khyon kun khyab par mdzod// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// gzhis byes lam gsum dus rnams thams cad du// lus dang grib bzhin mi 'bral rtag 'grogs nas// byang chub bar du srung skyobs g.yel med mdzod// phyi nang gsang la 'tshe zhing bar gcod pa'i// zhing bcu log 'dren dgra bgegs bdud sde'i dpung*// skad cig drag shul rol pa'i stobs kyis sgrol// thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod// nad dang rims yams gdon dang 'byung po'i tshogs// 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa// mi mthun gnod pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad kun// ma lus myur ba nyid du zhi bar mdzod// khams gsum srid gsum gzugs can gzugs med sogs// snang srid skye 'gro che rgu ma lus pa'i// blo yid mos pa rnam bzhi rang dbang du// gang bsam dbang du 'du ba'i phrin las mdzod// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang sogs// bde skyid yar zla'i dpal la 'gran pa dang*// dge legs dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa kun// gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod// mdor na zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams kun// gang bsam thogs med yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// ci bcol phrin las rab 'byams ma lus pa// skad cig ma thogs myur du 'grub par mdzod// ces mchod gtor gtsang sar phul la phrin las bcol/

zhes pa'ang deng dus rang lugs stag sham srung ma'i gsol mchod 'bras snye gsar rnying tsam yang ma thon par gzhan lugs cho ga btang tshe gsol mchod bsdus pa zhig ma thon na srung ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba yong 'dug pas rang dang rjes 'jug tsho la rgyun du ngag 'don ched ri lugs gsol kha bzhin kho bo nam mkha' dri med rab 'byams pas shar mar bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
